_what: The styleProfile equivalent for our seven LIVE caption styles, read from src/remotion/src/captions/<Style>/<Style>.tsx — the defaults in each exported component's own signature, which is what renders when ChatCut supplies nothing. Not transcribed from the types.ts doc comments: a stale comment is read as fact by the next person, including the person who wrote it.

_canvas.note: fontSize values are px at this canvas; every style then applies its own shrink-to-fit

_safe_area.source: shared/captionPosition.ts CAPTION_PADDING — TikTok safe area; bottom 420 clears the caption/progress/nav drawer and sidesSafe 200 clears the right action rail

_why_gadzhi_first: It is our closest analogue to Story Yellow — one keyword lit in yellow on plain white — so a field-by-field comparison against that template is meaningful and any mismatch is about the SCHEMA rather than about a style with no counterpart. A style with no counterpart would make a schema failure and a design difference look the same.

TwoTone.note: the only style with a real stroke

Lumen.note: keyword switches to Playfair Display 400 at 1.3x; a shine word at 1.6x

Prime.note: special words switch to Playfair Display

Pulse.note: keyword at 1.25x with a glow off the highlight colour; recoloured off blue deliberately because Prime owns blue

Cove.note: boxed words switch to Playfair Display 400 at 1.8x
